subject: GGally bug - ggally_diagAxis fails with NA values

messages.author: d2ca95393bc23535
messages.subject: GGally bug - ggally_diagAxis fails with NA values
parts:
Hello,
I just discovered GGally, which looks good. However, I found what
seems to be a bug, diagAxis fails with NA values. Example:

test_ggally_data <- data.frame(x=c(1:4,NA), y=1:5,
z=c('A','A','B','B','B'))
ggally_diagAxis(test_ggally_data, aes(x = x))
ggally_diagAxis(test_ggally_data, aes(x = y))
ggpairs( test_ggally_data )
ggpairs( na.omit(test_ggally_data) )

The reason I don't want to use na.omit is that I am comparing a bunch
of datasets which each have different values missing.

Presumably this should be easy to fix?

I hope this is the right mailing list for the post.

Thanks
Edward
